title: 901. Cat and Mouse

examples.explanation: With perfect play neither side can force a win, so the game is a draw.
The mouse starts next to the hole and steps into it on the first move.
The cat cuts off the only path, so the mouse is caught.

hints: Model each situation as (mouse node, cat node, whose turn) and work backwards from positions whose outcome is known.
The mouse reaching node 0 is a mouse win; both players landing together is a cat win.
A player picks a winning move when one exists, otherwise they delay; positions that never resolve are draws.
